meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你从现有成果出发，筛选有潜力的深度学习新方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做研究中已有一定的对比结果，想探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Find and vet novel deep learning research directions from your current results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have baselines and want to explore new research ideas

howto.what: 在你授权做候选方案探索后,它会先读懂代码仓库,冻结任务、数据集、评估与预算,给候选想法打分排序,再逐个跑小规模实验,结果写进 explore_outputs/,并附变更与可比性报告。
howto.when: 当你明确授权做候选方案探索(如候选方案、隔离分支、参数扫描等),并且已有可复用的 current_research 上下文时接管;窄范围改代码或跑实验、README 复现则交给其他技能。

say.text: 在当前研究分支上探索几个候选改进,先排序再跑。
say.note: 会先冻结任务与评估,再逐个候选做小规模验证。

say.text: 冻结数据集和评估标准,给候选想法打分排序。
say.note: 产出打分明细与门控理由。

say.text: 把候选实验证据写进 explore_outputs,并生成可比性报告。

howto.what_en: After you authorize candidate-only exploration, it reads the repo, freezes task, dataset, evaluation and budget, ranks candidate ideas, runs one bounded candidate at a time, and writes results and reports to explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Use when the request has both exploration authorization (candidate-only work, isolated branch, sweep, etc.) and a durable current_research context. Narrow code-only or run-only requests go elsewhere.

say_en.text: Explore a few candidate improvements on my current research branch.
say_en.note: It ranks ideas, freezes the task and evaluation, then tests each.

say_en.text: Freeze dataset and evaluation criteria from current_research, then score ideas.
say_en.note: You get scored idea rankings with gate reasons.

say_en.text: Write candidate evidence to explore_outputs and add a comparability report.
say_en.note: Scientific changelog is included as well.
